title: Faqat 50 xil so'z bilan yozilgan kitob nima bo'ldi?
hook: Bu kitobda bor-yo'g'i 50 xil so'z bor.

scenes.text: 1960 yilda chiqqan bir bolalar kitobida bor-yo'g'i 50 xil so'z ishlatilgan.
Aytilishicha, noshir Bennet Serf muallif bilan 50 ta so'zdan oshirmay kitob yoza olmaysan, deb garov o'ynagan.
Muallif Doktor Syuss edi. Kitob nomi Green Eggs and Ham.
Bu kitob ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p sotilgan bolalar kitoblaridan biriga aylandi.
Cheklov uni to'xtatmadi. Aksincha, eng mashhur ishlaridan biriga sabab bo'ldi.

description:
Doktor Syussning 1960 yilda chiqqan Green Eggs and Ham kitobida atigi 50 xil so'z bor. Aytilishicha, bunga noshir Bennet Serf bilan qilingan garov sabab bo'lgan. Kitob ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p sotilgan bolalar kitoblaridan biri.

Siz cheklov sababli yaxshiroq ish qilgan paytingiz bo'lganmi? Izohda yozing.
source: Fact-checked 2026-11-22 (via web search summaries; direct page fetch was blocked). Wikipedia: Green Eggs and Ham, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Green_Eggs_and_Ham (published 12 Aug 1960; exactly 50 distinct words; Bennett Cerf, Seuss's editor/publisher at Random House, bet him $50 he could not do it after The Cat in the Hat, which used 236 words); Marketplace/APM, https://www.marketplace.org/story/2010/08/12/50-year-feast-50-words-happy-birthday-green-eggs-ham (Seuss's own account of the bet, so the bet stays attributed with 'aytilishicha'); Publishers Weekly all-time children's hardcover bestsellers via Education Week 1989, https://www.edweek.org/education/all-time-best-selling-childrens-books/1989/11 (Green Eggs and Ham 5th, 3.68 million copies at that time) and PW 2001 list, https://www.publishersweekly.com/pw/print/20011217/28595-all-time-bestselling-children-s-books.html.
